name: PBD Balance Zone Scalping
description: PBD (Price/Balance/Direction) methodology by Trades to Traders: candle bodies define a fair-value balance zone. Three setups: (1) fake breakout — price exits zone and re-enters, counter-trade against the false move; (2) balance abandonment — strong breakout with displacement, trade in breakout direction; (3) balance re-acceptance — price returns to zone after extended move, fade to zone centre. market_structure (BOS/CHOCH) confirms directional bias; displacement filters for impulsive moves.
hypothesis: Price oscillates between balance (body overlap zones) and expansion. Fake breakouts from the balance zone provide the highest-probability counter-trade setups. ML learns which combinations of bz_fake_bear/bull, bz_in_balance, bz_zone_width, ms_choch_bull/bear, and displacement features produce the sharpest edges. London and New York kill zones are expected to dominate.
expected_outcome: bz_fake_bear and bz_fake_bull selected as top features. Higher win rate on fake setups when bz_in_balance=1 (tight zone) and displacement confirms re-entry impulse. Breakout abandonment trades filter well with ms_trend alignment.
